============================================================
**David W. Gordon is the Sacramento County Superintendent of Schools serving in the 2025–2026 school year.** [4][1]

## Current Leadership
David W. Gordon has led the Sacramento County Office of Education (SCOE) for over 20 years and remains in the role as of February 2026. [7][1] He announced his retirement effective June 30, 2027, allowing ample time for a successor search. [4]

## Search Process
The SCOE Board initiated a superintendent search in late 2025, with community engagement in February 2026, applications due March 31, 2026, interviews in May 2026, and a potential start date after June 2026. [4][1] No successor has been appointed or started by February 2026, confirming Gordon's tenure through the 2025–2026 school year (Aug 2025–Jun 2026). [1]

LEAID=1742840 | Winnetka SD 36, ILLINOIS | Step 1
============================================================
Based on my research of the district website, Illinois state education records, and recent news sources, I have found clear and consistent information about the superintendent for the 2025–2026 school year.

**Dr. Kelly Tess is the superintendent of Winnetka School District 36 for the 2025–2026 school year.** [2][5][10] Dr. Tess was promoted to superintendent effective July 2022  and continues to serve in this role with no departure announced. [2]

## Background

Dr. Tess has over 20 years of experience in education, including prior roles as a classroom teacher, elementary and middle school assistant principal, middle school principal (The Skokie School), and assistant superintendent. [2] She holds a Bachelor of Science in Media Studies from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, a Master of Elementary Education from DePaul University, a Master of Arts in Educational Leadership from Concordia University, and a Doctorate in Educational Leadership from DePaul University. [2] She is a member of a national cohort through The School Superintendents Association (AASA) and has been recognized by the National School Public Relations Association (NSPRA) as one of 25 superintendents nationally designated as a "Superintendent to Watch." [2]

LEAID=3703310 | Craven County Board of Education, NORTH CAROLINA | Step 1
============================================================
**Dr. Matthew Cheeseman is the superintendent of Craven County Schools for the 2025–2026 school year (Aug 2025 – Jun 2026), having assumed the role on February 1, 2026.[1][5][1]**

## Leadership Timeline
Dr. Wendy A. Miller resigned effective around late May 2025 after serving since July 2021; Michelle Lee briefly acted as superintendent during the immediate transition.[3][7]  
Richard L. Stout, Jr., was appointed interim superintendent effective May 1, 2025, followed by Dr. Stuart Blount as interim effective January 1, 2026, to bridge until the permanent hire.[1][6][1][5]  
The Board approved Dr. Cheeseman on December 16, 2025 (effective February 1, 2026), with oath taken January 13, 2026; he previously led Beaufort County Schools.[5][9]

## Current Status
As of February 2026 (school year ongoing), Dr. Cheeseman is the serving superintendent per district news and reports, outweighing outdated static pages listing prior leaders.[5][8][1]

LEAID=5006930 | Rockingham School District, VERMONT | Step 1
============================================================
## Overview
Rockingham School District (NCES LEAID 5006930) is a component district of the Windham Northeast Supervisory Union (WNESU) in Vermont, serving pre-K to grade 8 in Bellows Falls and surrounding areas with three schools.[2] In Vermont's supervisory union structure, the superintendent is employed by the supervisory union board and oversees operations across component districts, including Rockingham.

## Leadership
Andrew Haas is the superintendent of Windham Northeast Supervisory Union, providing oversight for Rockingham School District during the 2025–2026 school year.[1] District records confirm Haas in the role as of January 28, 2025, with no reports of departure or interim replacement by February 2026.[1] No separate superintendent is listed for the small component district; principals handle individual schools.[2]

============================================================
**Angela Lunsford is the superintendent (principal) of Catamount School for the 2025–2026 school year.** [2][1]

## District Overview
Catamount School (NCES LEAID 3700421) is a small regular public school district in Cullowhee, North Carolina, operating grades 6-8 as a lab school on Western Carolina University's campus in partnership with Jackson County Public Schools. [4][1] As a single-school district, the principal serves as the top leader. 

## Leadership Confirmation
The official staff page lists Angela Lunsford as Principal, with contact details: alunsford@wcu.edu, phone 828-227-7500. [2] This page reflects current operations into 2026, with no news of changes or a job posting filled for 2025-26.  Earlier mentions like Sarah Tatham appear outdated or for other roles. [6]

LEAID=5000423 | Rochester Stockbridge Unified School District #81, VERMONT | Step 1
============================================================
**Michael J. Clark is the superintendent overseeing Rochester Stockbridge Unified School District #81 for the 2025–2026 school year, as the top leader of its supervisory union.** [3][2]

## District Context
Rochester Stockbridge Unified School District #81 (NCES LEAID 5000423) is a small regular public school district in Royalton, Vermont, and a component of a supervisory union, likely Orange Southwest Supervisory Union (previously referenced as OWSU at owsu.org, now orangesouthwest.org). [1][2] Its official websites (rsudschools.org and owsu.org) do not list a district-specific superintendent; instead, leadership falls under the supervisory union's central office. [1][2]

## Leadership Details
Michael J. Clark serves as Superintendent of Orange Southwest Supervisory Union, which includes oversight of component districts like Rochester Stockbridge. His biography on the union's central office page details over 28 years in education, prior roles as superintendent in Grand Isle (2018–2024) and Essex-Caledonia, and his current position supporting schools in the region. [3][2] A 2024 news report confirms his hiring for the Randolph-area schools (Orange Southwest), with no updates indicating departure as of early 2026. [9]

No evidence shows a district-specific superintendent, principal acting as top leader, or changes for 2025–2026; small districts like this typically share union leadership. [1][6]

LEAID=3413890 | River Edge School District, NEW JERSEY | Step 1
============================================================
The superintendent's page doesn't display the name in this content. However, based on my search results, I have sufficient information to provide a comprehensive answer.

## Superintendent Information

**Dr. Nicholas A. Bernice** is the superintendent of River Edge School District for the 2025–2026 school year [8]. He was appointed by the River Edge Board of Education and began his role on July 1, 2024 [8]. Prior to joining River Edge, Dr. Bernice served as superintendent of Ringwood Public Schools for eight years and was named the 2024 New Jersey Superintendent of the Year [8]. As of February 2026, he continues to serve in this position with no reported departures or changes in leadership [9].

LEAID=3408490 | Lenape Regional High School District, NEW JERSEY | Step 1
============================================================
**Matthew D. Webb is the superintendent of the Lenape Regional High School District for the 2025–2026 school year.** [1][2]

## Appointment Details
The LRHSD Board of Education unanimously approved Matthew Webb, previously the assistant superintendent, as the new superintendent effective September 1, 2025, succeeding Carol Birnbohm, Ed.D., who retired after 13 years. [1][2] This transition occurred during a July 23, 2025, board meeting, well before the school year began in August 2025. [1]

## Current Confirmation
The district's official administration page lists Matthew D. Webb as Superintendent of Schools as of recent updates in 2026. [4] A December 2025 news recap confirms he succeeded Birnbohm on September 1, 2025, with his contract through June 30, 2029.

LEAID=5000438 | Mountain View Union Elementary School District #94, VERMONT | Step 1
============================================================
Mountain View Union Elementary School District #94 (Hardwick, VT) is a small district comprising multiple K-6 campuses (Hardwick Elementary, Woodbury Elementary, and Lakeview Early Education Center preschool) under the Orleans Southwest Supervisory Union (OSSU).[2]

## Leadership Structure
It lacks a dedicated superintendent; instead, two principals oversee operations across campuses: **William (Bill) Deiss** (Principal, Hardwick Elementary) and **Beth Parker** (Principal, Woodbury Elementary; Director, Lakeview Early Education Center).[8][2]

## Supervisory Union Oversight
OSSU Superintendent is **Dr. David Baker**, serving as of January 2025 with no departure news through February 2026 (a new superintendent, Rebecca Tatistcheff, was selected February 2026, but start date unspecified).
